mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, potentially increasing aspirin metabolite levels and GI toxicity risk; clarithromycin may increase bleeding risk when combined with antiplatelet effects of aspirin.
action: Monitor for signs of GI bleeding or ulceration; consider alternative antibiotic if high-dose aspirin or prolonged clarithromycin therapy is needed; assess bleeding risk in patients on antiplatelet aspirin therapy.
